fullName: UPSC Civil Services (Preliminary) – General Studies Paper I

coverage.note: Subject-wise question counts are from PW OnlyIAS's 2025 analysis (topics below); earlier years 2018–2024 from the same page vary a lot (e.g. Environment 7 in 2025, 21 in 2023). Difficulty is only published as labels, so no percentages. Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying (33%) and not modelled. Verified 29 Oct 2026 against the cited sources.

sections.name: General Studies I
sections.style: multi-statement ('How many of the above…'), assertion–reason and pair-matching

pattern.notes: One-third of the marks for a question are deducted for a wrong answer (0.66 of 2).

topics.subject: GS
topics.name: History (Ancient, Medieval, Modern) and Art & Culture

notes: About 67% of 2025 GS I questions were multi-statement formats (PW OnlyIAS).
Since 2023 the 'how many of the above' format makes elimination harder (PW: 2023 was the toughest paper).
History is usually considered the toughest GS subject (PW).

traps: 'Only one / only two / all three / none' counts — one misjudged statement makes the answer wrong.
Extreme words (always, only, never) in statements.
Negative marking of 1/3: avoid blind guesses.
